definition: In natural language processing, IOB tagging (abbreviation for Inside–outside–beginning) (or BIO tagging) is a common format for tagging tokens in a chunking task.
details: IOB stands for "inside, outside, beginning". It was proposed in 1995.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is IOB tagging — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
